# From scattered searches to instant insight: Why Iron Mountain unified its enterprise search with Elastic


By


[Emily Chioconi](https://www.elastic.co/blog/author/emily-chioconi)


November 23, 2026

As enterprise data volumes grow rapidly, uncovering critical information across complex document repositories becomes hugely challenging. And feeding autonomous AI agents accurate, relevant context without drowning them in noise has become one of the defining challenges enterprises face. Fragmented search infrastructure doesn't just slow down human users; it limits how effectively AI agents can reason over enterprise knowledge, forcing teams to choose between broad context and precise retrieval.


Search strategies have naturally evolved to address requirements spanning multiple disparate data sources, driving the consolidation of these complex needs into a simplified underlying structure. By consolidating its search infrastructure paths into


[Elasticsearch](https://www.elastic.co/elasticsearch) within Iron Mountain InSight® DXP,


[Iron Mountain](https://www.ironmountain.com/) simplified workflows, optimized query performance, and built the fluid knowledge foundation autonomous agents need to operate reliably at scale. This strategic shift transformed backend discovery constraints into a scalable, enterprise-ready engine optimized for sub-second retrieval augmented generation (RAG) and


[hybrid search](https://www.elastic.co/what-is/hybrid-search) .


## Evolving search architecture to meet growing enterprise needs


As enterprise search capabilities continue to evolve rapidly, search architectures must evolve in step to meet increasingly complex data demands. That's why Iron Mountain evolved the architecture powering the search function within


[InSight DXP](https://www.ironmountain.com/services/insight-digital-experience-platform) , Iron Mountain's AI-powered intelligent content platform. It unifies search models across varied data sources to reduce operational complexity, streamline synchronization pipelines, and lessen latency bottlenecks, delivering seamless query performance.


Modern search demands efficient indexing and memory management to support large-scale hybrid queries across large volumes of documents and vector embeddings while maintaining consistent performance at scale. By evolving to a unified search platform, InSight DXP now processes full-text indices and dense vector embeddings simultaneously, delivering continuous scalability and responsive, faster performance as document collections grow to petabyte scale.


Enterprise information also extends well beyond text documents; it spans images, audio recordings, video, and telemetry. InSight DXP now aligns these multimodal inputs into a shared semantic space, giving AI agents the ability to reason across complex, multi-format workflows.


## Unifying enterprise hybrid search with Elasticsearch


Iron Mountain unified its search framework into Elasticsearch, giving InSight DXP a robust foundation built specifically for enterprise discovery. By combining native inverted text indices and vector search capabilities within a single engine, Iron Mountain replaced legacy query paths with more efficient, faster retrieval. These core technical implementations delivered distinct operational advantages, each solving a real challenge enterprises face today.


### Native hybrid search and reciprocal rank fusion (RRF)


Modern search requires balancing semantic understanding with precise term matching.


***Iron Mountain’s approach:***


****


Combine exact keyword matching with AI vector embeddings in a single query pass using


[RRF](https://www.elastic.co/docs/reference/elasticsearch/rest-apis/reciprocal-rank-fusion) , enabling highly accurate results while preserving domain-specific terminology.


### Parent-child data modeling


Enterprise permission structures are complex and constantly evolving.


***Iron Mountain’s approach:***


****


Structure document chunks as linked child records that support granular metadata filtering, allowing access permissions and field updates to propagate more efficiently without requiring full index rebuilds.


### Re-embedding efficiency and pipeline optimization


Keeping embeddings aligned with active document repositories is critical for real-time AI performance.


***Iron Mountain’s approach:***


****


Streamline embedding generation and document updates within a unified pipeline, so model updates require minimal compute resources while maintaining system continuity.


### Unified indexing infrastructure


Accessing knowledge across distributed systems requires a cohesive approach.


***Iron Mountain’s approach:***


****


Consolidate full-text and vector data into a single scalable platform, improving operational efficiency while enhancing system reliability and search performance.


## Accelerating Iron Mountain's enterprise information strategy


Enterprise search has outgrown its role as a background utility; it is now the foundation on which AI readiness is built. By unifying unstructured documents, media, and rich metadata into a single Elasticsearch-powered semantic layer within InSight DXP, Iron Mountain helps to eliminate information silos and now delivers Accurate, Pertinent, and Trusted (APT) knowledge directly to teams and AI agents. Elevating search into a dynamic, context-aware engine has enabled


[Iron Mountain](https://www.ironmountain.com/) to move beyond simple retrieval, accelerating decision-making and driving increased workforce productivity.


Ready to transform your organization's data from a passive archive into an active source of intelligence?


[Learn more about Insight DXP](https://www.ironmountain.com/services/insight-digital-experience-platform) or contact Iron Mountain's experts to request a personalized demonstration.


*Iron Mountain's journey shows what's possible when full-text, vector, and hybrid search run on a single engine instead of separate systems stitched together. Whether you're powering enterprise search, retrieval augmented generation, or agentic applications,*
